regression.scope: Conan and all existing community refinements including Azazel repeated same-source curse reversal, plus sleep, stealth, full vision, status costs, hooks, source grants and purity.

typecheckScope: Typechecks precede the final one-line control-extension fix and its additional test; final Editor release gate validates the integrated tree.
initialFailures: Target cost field was initially inserted under toggle upkeep; moved to statusCost before successful compile.
Seen-event IDs initially contained uppercase characters; normalized to legal lowercase IDs.
Actual zero damage and shield-only hits woke sleeping targets; fixed positive HP damage guard and verified through the real damage pipeline.
semantics: Each visible hostile champion is observed only inside the same active unsettled duel, respecting stealth and map sight.

Four event categories each count once per observed enemy and observer per round; at most three stored clues. Consuming clues does not erase seen categories; ordinary death/revive does not reset round sources.
R consumes only the selected target clues applied by this caster; illegal or unfunded casts pay nothing. Legal cast interrupted before effect does not refund.
R reveal preserves the underlying stealth clock, expires or dispels with its source and stops across duel zones; same caster refreshes one weakness source.
Q and W use real first-collision projectiles. W causes no direct damage; subsequent positive HP loss wakes it, zero damage and shield-only absorption do not.
knownLimits: E skateboard steering/collision/stop states and EX valid-target-or-anchor bounded pull remain unfinished.
Football, needle/watch, skating, dedicated models/animations/VFX/audio and rendered visual acceptance remain pending; Q/W still use an existing bolt proxy.
All-hero original-design acceptance, current-service ZIP and formal publication remain incomplete.

controlRefreshRegression.result: Effective visible control extension now counts, unchanged expiry does not.
